payout_quote: The Board of Elections pays Poll Workers $300 per election and $25 for every required class.
steps: Confirm you are 18 or older and a registered voter enrolled in the Democratic or Republican Party
Contact the Rockland County Board of Elections at (845) 638-5172 to sign up as a Poll Worker or Election Inspector
Attend and pass the required certification classes
Work your assigned Election District on Primary and General Election Days
catches: Must be a registered voter enrolled in the Democratic or Republican Party -- unaffiliated voters cannot serve as inspectors
Very long day: 5:30 A.M. start until after the polls close at 9:00 P.M.
$300 is a flat per-election-day rate, not hourly
$25 class pay is per required class attended
County notes pay rates and salaries are subject to change
biggest_catch: Party enrollment is mandatory (Democratic or Republican only) and each election day runs 5:30 A.M. to after 9:00 P.M.
eligibility: 18 years or older; registered voter of Rockland County enrolled in the Democratic or Republican Party
timing: Work day begins 5:30 A.M. and ends after the polls close at 9:00 P.M.; Rockland County staffs 307 election districts for elections throughout the year
weasel_words: Pay rates and salaries are subject to change.
